matrix-stack-status.purpose: Check whether the Matrix stack service is active on macai.
matrix-stack-status.impact: Reads the systemd state of matrix-stack.service.
matrix-stack-status.verification: Exit 0 confirms that the stack unit is active.

failure_reasons.3: The Matrix stack service is inactive.
failure_reasons.4: The Matrix stack service was not found.

matrix-monitor-restart.purpose: Restart the Matrix resource collector on macai.
matrix-monitor-restart.impact: Restarts matrix-monitor.service. Sampling pauses while it starts.
matrix-monitor-restart.verification: Exit 0 confirms systemd completed the restart job.
matrix-monitor-restart.recovery: Check the service status and journal from the VPS console if the collector fails to start.

failure_reasons.1: Systemd did not complete the collector restart. Check matrix-monitor.service on the VPS.

matrix-backup-timer-restart.purpose: Restart the Matrix backup timer on macai.
matrix-backup-timer-restart.impact: Rearms matrix-backup.timer. Its persistent schedule may trigger a missed backup.
matrix-backup-timer-restart.verification: Exit 0 confirms systemd started the timer.
matrix-backup-timer-restart.recovery: Check the next scheduled run with systemctl list-timers from the VPS console.

failure_reasons.1: Systemd did not complete the timer restart. Check matrix-backup.timer on the VPS.
